# waroom_on_call_escalation_policy (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Waroom on-call escalation policy. Look it up by exactly one of `uuid` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an escalation policy by name.
data "waroom_on_call_escalation_policy" "example" {
  name = "Primary escalation"
}

# Or by UUID.
data "waroom_on_call_escalation_policy" "by_uuid" {
  uuid = "770e8400-e29b-41d4-a716-446655440001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the escalation policy to look up. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set. It is an error if no policy or more than one policy has this name.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the escalation policy to look up. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `call_depth` (Number) How many people, counted from the on-duty user, are called in each step's team. `null` means unlimited (everyone in the team).
- `call_traversal` (String) The order in which steps and people are called: `depth_first` or `breadth_first`.
- `id` (String) Escalation policy ID. This is an alias for `uuid`.
- `steps` (Attributes List) The escalation steps, in escalation order (ascending `position`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))
- `time_slots` (Attributes List) The days of the week and times when the escalation policy is active, ordered by `day_of_week` and `start_time`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_slots))
- `timezone` (String) The timezone (IANA format, e.g. `Asia/Tokyo`) that `time_slots` are interpreted in.

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Read-Only:

- `position` (Number) The escalation order of the step, starting from 0.
- `simultaneous_call` (Boolean) Whether all participants of the team's active rotation are called at the same time in this step.
- `step_type` (String) The type of the step: `primary` or `fallback`.
- `team` (Attributes) The on-call team called in this step. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps--team))
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the step.

<a id="nestedatt--steps--team"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps.team`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) The color of the on-call team in hex format without the `#` prefix.
- `name` (String) The name of the on-call team.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the on-call team.



<a id="nestedatt--time_slots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_slots`

Read-Only:

- `day_of_week` (Number) The day of the week (0 is Sunday, 6 is Saturday).
- `end_time` (String) The end time (`HH:MM`) in the policy's `timezone`. If it is earlier than `start_time`, the slot continues into the next day.
- `start_time` (String) The start time (`HH:MM`) in the policy's `timezone`.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the time slot.
